verdict: Leads are arriving, but none are reaching your intake pipeline.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Meta delivered 91 leads at a $23.20 cost per lead — steady against your recent average — but none of those leads are showing up as active opportunities in your pipeline. That gap points to a break in the intake process after the lead arrives, not a problem with the advertising itself. Separately, your Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply this past week, which is reducing local visibility and adding pressure on overall volume. We're actively working to identify and close the intake gap so that the leads you're already paying for begin moving forward as expected.
